verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Svelte components are written in the HTML, CSS and JavaScript developers already know and compiled into optimized JavaScript. A `<style>` block inside a component is scoped to that component, and state is just a plain variable you update normally, which shows markup, styling and logic living together in one declarative component. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the single-file authoring model (community comments praise simplicity but do not describe the component format directly).
